messages.content: Build the strongest chess engine in 4 KB of Python.

I will adapt the Sunfish micro-engine, minify it safely via AST, compress it with LZMA, and package it as a Python ZIP executable to fit within 4KB. I have fixed the FEN adapter to correctly handle the (depth, score, gamma, move) return signature of Sunfish's search tree. I will not forge token usage.
